verdict.rationale: BVNK is stablecoin and fiat payments infrastructure (wallets, virtual accounts, pay-ins and payouts via API). Plugging MCP servers in so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client or agent-host role, which is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows BVNK acting as an MCP client; the agent-wallet-cli probe is a CLI, not an MCP-client capability.
